title: opjson sets
description: sets/sets.json: every set a printing can belong to. Bandai's series, plus the TCGplayer groups that are not one Bandai series (stamp groups and promo lines).

type.description: The set's product line. AutoMana maps it onto MTG's set types: booster=expansion, premium_booster=masters, starter_deck and ultra_deck=starter, box_set=box.

parent.description: The set this one hangs off, as MTG's parent_set: a pre-release, release-event or anniversary stamp set names the booster whose printings it stamps.

source.description: Present when the set exists only on TCGplayer.
